instruction: Resize the image to 50% of its original dimensions using command line tools and save the result as "resized.png" on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "alt", "t"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires resizing the image to 50% (481x640 from original 962x1280) using command line (e.g., ImageMagick convert -resize 50% or GIMP). The evaluator uses the existing check_image_size function which verifies the result dimensions match the expected 481x640 pixels.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts the result file from the expected path /home/user/Desktop/resized.png
Metric check_image_size correctly verifies image dimensions (481x640) match the expected 50% resize of original (962x1280)
Complete coverage: evaluator checks resize percentage (via dimensions), output filename (resized.png), and output location (Desktop)
Data flow is correct: getter extracts file → metric opens and checks dimensions → compares against expected
Edge cases handled: metric returns 0.0 if file is missing, handles transparent images appropriately
No postconfig needed: file operations persist after task execution
